spatial_association.note: Deterministic geometric containment within operational refinery perimeter; 412 m from cataloged flare centroid.

behavioural_assessment.note: FRP exceeds p75 baseline threshold for facility off-zone activity, triggering advisory investigation.

heuristic_source_hypotheses.basis: Heuristic geographic buffer, land cover (industrial), and facility baseline history.

uncertainty_assessment.interpretation: Competing hypotheses between standard flaring off-zone and uncontained industrial unit fire.

thermal_discriminator_advisory.interpretation: Advisory score strongly favors GAS_FLARE over WILDFIRE_CONFIRMED based on compact midwave-to-longwave spectral contrast (delta T = 13.2 K) and tropical background temperature.
limitations: Evaluated binary task is GAS_FLARE vs. WILDFIRE_CONFIRMED only.
Cannot assess INDUSTRIAL_FIRE (structural/refinery fires not represented in training).
Cannot assess AGRICULTURAL_BURN (crop residue fires not represented).
Score is conditional on the trained task and is NOT a calibrated probability of real-world fire occurrence.
Does not override spatial containment or empirical baseline.

next_best_evidence.rationale: The experimental thermal discriminator favors gas flaring over wildland biomass fire, but cannot distinguish between routine flare operation and an uncontained industrial structure fire. Sentinel-2 SWIR band 12 imagery is required to resolve emitter sub-pixel geometry and confirm stack containment.

investigation_priority.label: Prototype Investigation Priority
reasons: Thermal activity detected inside facility boundary but outside designated flare zones (FACILITY_OFF_ZONE).
FRP is ELEVATED relative to historical facility median.
Experimental thermal discriminator indicates radiometric signature matches point-source flaring rather than landscape wildfire, but industrial non-flare fire remains an unresolved hypothesis.
